content.text:
Finding submitted.

**Summary:** ASSIGN is a **deviation** (walk-away territory) on two counts:

1. **Article XXIV(c) (p0149)** — blanket bar on any Licensee assignment or transfer without Licensor's consent, with no affiliate or M&A carve-out and no reciprocal limit on Licensor (who could assign to our competitors).
2. **Article XX(a) (p0134)** — any Change of Control of Licensee *automatically terminates* the Agreement and all our licences unless Licensor consents, with Licensor deemed reasonable in refusing on broad self-interest grounds.

**Cure (preferred level, two surgical replacements):** Licensee may assign without consent to an Affiliate or to a successor in a merger, acquisition or sale of all or substantially all assets (other Licensee assignments still need consent, preserving the existing bargain); Licensor may not assign without our consent, not unreasonably withheld, and never to a Licensee competitor; and Article XX(a) is inverted so no Change of Control gives Licensor a termination right, while the retained "CHANGE OF CONTROL" and "CONTROL" definitions and the p0149 cross-reference remain operative.
